event.description: Reduce the learned positional factorization from retained rank 7 to rank 6 while retaining the 45000-step learning-rate-floor schedule, d=14, h=2, L=2, and ff=20.
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 3381 parameters at 99.890000%, a +0.890000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the current rank-7 representation was accepted as attempt-0025 under the successful training-control schedule (3381, 99.89%); the prior rank-6 micro-trial in attempt-0013 failed under the earlier 30000-step zero-ending schedule, peaking at 10.25% validation; 5 prior position-representation macro-attempts plus the rank-7 schedule reattempt. Hypothesis: one fewer learned positional coordinate may still preserve fixed-format position roles when paired with the retained 45000-step, nonzero-tail schedule that qualified rank 7; this is a representational factorization, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning, and reduces actual parameters from 3381 to 3332. It is more informative than the nearest untested rank-5 alternative because rank 6 directly tests the next one-coordinate boundary under the changed training condition that invalidated the earlier standard-schedule result.
